lines.t: I pray night and day asking you to take these things away
That are dragging me down
Help clean this filth from my soul, make me pure and make me whole
Take away these things in my heart
That have been trying to pull me away from the star
Burn away the dross that's been covering me up
Clean me, Lord, come sweep my heart
Leave not a corner where the dust can start
Make me worthy for you
Help me put all this impurity away
Till only pure faith remains
Whispers in the wind saying
Come with us in sin
And you'll feel good again
And I used to believe their lies
But now them I despise
Help me put away the sins I did
Help me face the wrong from which I hid
Lord, wash me till I'm clean
Scrub off all the meat
Burn away the dross that's been covering me up
Clean me, Lord, come sweep my heart
Leave not a corner where the dust can start
Take me away before you help me
Put all this impurity away
Until only through your faith remain
Refine me
Clean me
Wipe the filth from my soul
Burn away the trust in all my sins of yesterday
Make me new in your love
Help clean me today
I've walked through the dust
Tried doing it all on my own
But you meet me right where I'm standing
And call this tired heart back home
Thank you for watching.
